diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves vendor integration profiles by config_id using a detailed Pydantic dataclass response_model. It fails to check if config.organization_id == current_user.organization_id, allowing tenants to extract proprietary webhook signing secrets and client TLS certificates of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /integrations/vendor-configs/842 HTTP/1.1
Host: hub.integrations.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>
